device.description: 14-bit 1.5 MSPS dual simultaneous-sampling fully-differential SAR ADC with internal references and dual-SDO serial interface
device.note: ads7851.pdf (SBAS587A, ADS7251/ADS7851) p.3 terminal descriptions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.6 electrical characteristics (DVDD 1.65-5.25 V), p.9 ADS7851 timing (Figure 2), p.20 transfer characteristics (Table 1, twos complement), p.21-22 serial interface (Table 2, short-cycling)

pages: p.3 (terminals), p.4 (ROC), p.6 (DVDD range, digital levels), p.9 (ADS7851 timing, Figure 2), p.20 (Table 1 transfer characteristics), p.21-22 (serial interface, Table 2 data launch edge, short-cycling)
notModeled: analog inputs and the two internal references (REFOUT-A/B never driven): both ADCs return the 0 V code 0000h
SDO-B (ADC_B result) is never driven; only SDO-A shifts the frame (the two pins carry identical-format frames, 0 0 D13..D0)
conversion is clocked by SCLK (tCONV = tSU_CSCK + 14 tCLK): not timed, the 0 V code is available at once

SPI phase: Figure 2 shows SCLK idling high and data changing after SCLK rising edges (tD_CKDO), read on falling edges (mode 2, 16 cells: 0, 0, D13..D0); Table 2 lists the falling edge as the launch edge. Modeled as Figure 2
short-cycling (CS high before 16 SCLK rising edges aborts the frame) and throughput / tACQ limits
variants: ADS7251 (12-bit, 2 MSPS, 14-clock frame 0 0 D11..D0) shares ads7851.pdf; not in this batch
